requiredBehavior: Use the already selected single provider generation result; never add a capability probe, retry, transport replay, or second provider request.
Accept supported native transparency only after alpha inspection; route unknown, unsupported, and opaque-native results to the existing local background-removal queue.
Preserve the validated provider original and return a structured transparent-rendition failure when local processing fails; never claim transparent success for a failed fallback.
Keep provider request counts and possible-billing metadata unchanged while applying local transparency to final outputs.

directSpecifications.reason: Defines native alpha acceptance, opaque/unknown/unsupported local fallback, no replay and original-preserving failure.
Defines four-state transparency routing through one provider attempt and optional local inference.

reportingContract: Before activation send THREAD_HANDSHAKE and verify delivery. After activation use direct messages for every acceptance, activation, checkpoint, blocker, deviation and delivery; heartbeat and final answers never advance this task.
